what_this_catches: Local edits to the vendored copy. A test hashes the vendored file and compares it to sha256, so changing one without the other fails.
what_this_does_not_catch: Drift in the Brain after the commit named above. Nothing in this repository reads the Brain at build time, so a rename or reclassification there is invisible here until someone re-vendors. Detecting that needs a CI step with read access to the Brain, which this workflow does not have.
